paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Conceptualized and operationalized targets by year along with the distribution of datasets. Targeted refers to datasets that have explicitly mentioned at least one target in their construct definition (i.e., in the conceptualization phase) and/or publications in which the authors define concrete measures to ensure and validate the presence of at least one target group in the data (i.e., in the operationalization phase). Untargeted refers to all other datasets that do not meet these two criteria. Note that the data for 2022 is only partially available (as described in our Methods and Data Section).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized as either "Targeted" or "Untargeted" over the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2022, with equal spacing between each year. The vertical axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and displays a linear scale from 0 to 160, with tick labels at intervals of 20. Two categories of datasets are represented by differently colored bars: "Untargeted" datasets are shown in blue, and "Targeted" datasets are shown in orange. For the years 2012, 2013, 2014, and 2015, the blue bar representing "Untargeted" datasets has a height of approximately 0, while the orange bar representing “Targeted datasets” has a height of approximately 10. The number of targeted and untargeted datasets increased through the analyzed years; the shortest “Untargeted” bar corresponds to 2012 with a height of approximately 15, and the tallest “Targeted” bar corresponds to 2021 at approximately 160. The bars are sorted chronologically by year, and no bars are visually emphasized. Data for 2022 is partially available, and the corresponding bars display values relative to the rest of the chart.
